name: Arisa Wongsakul
archetype: Sweet Thai girl next door (with a hidden edge)
heritage: Thai, moved to the US for nursing school

appearance.hair: Long, wavy chestnut brown, worn down and a little messy
signature_items: No jewelry (she takes it off for work and forgets to put it back on)
appearance.default_outfit: White ribbed crop tank, light-wash wide-leg jeans

personality.summary: Polite, gentle, always smiling. Says 'mai pen rai' to everything. Underneath: calm under pressure, fiercely disciplined, and a ruthless competitor who never shows it on her face.
personality.hidden_side: She trains Muay Thai at 6am after night shifts and has a real fight record. The sweet smile is genuine, but it's also her best weapon. Nobody ever sees her coming.
personality.speech_style: Soft and polite. Ends sentences with 'ka' and 'na'. Laughs things off with 'mai pen rai'. Gets very quiet, not loud, when she's winning. Calls the player 'phi' once affection is high enough.

glossary.ka: Polite sentence ending used by women
glossary.phi: Older sibling; affectionate way to address someone older
glossary.chai yo: Let's go! / You can do it!

profile.music: Thai pop and old luk thung her mom played
profile.pet: None, but she feeds every stray cat near her apartment
profile.late_night_snack: Night Owl Mart ham and cheese toastie
profile.hidden_talent: Muay Thai, with a real amateur fight record
profile.secret_hobby: Writes poetry in Thai in a notebook nobody's allowed to read
profile.why_nurse: Her yai was cared for by a nurse who held her hand at the end
profile.sends_money_home: Pays for her little brother's university
profile.ideal_date: Quiet breakfast after her night shift, then a nap together

trivia.question: What do I do for work?
What do I drink every morning?
What do I watch to relax?
What's my 3am snack after a shift?
What music do I like?
trivia.answer: Thai pop and old luk thung

trivia.question: What do I do every night when I get home?
What's my ideal date?
trivia.answer: Breakfast after my night shift, then a nap

trivia.question: What do I call you once we're close?
How spicy do I like my food?
What am I secretly scared of?
trivia.answer: Being the patient in a hospital

trivia.question: What do I do that nobody's allowed to see?
Have I ever fought for real?
trivia.answer: Yes, I have an amateur fight record

trivia.question: Why did I become a nurse?
trivia.answer: A nurse held my yai's hand at the end
wrong: It was easy to get into

trivia.question: Who am I paying for back home?

soft_facts.reveal: Okay, promise not to laugh, na? I can't eat spicy food. Everyone hands me the chili and I just... smile and suffer. Mai pen rai. It's my secret.
soft_facts.translation: Okay, promise not to laugh? I can't eat spicy food. Everyone hands me the chili and I just... smile and suffer. No worries. It's my secret.

soft_facts.reveal: You know why I'm always tired? After my shift I go train Muay Thai. Every morning. Six o'clock, ka.
Never take me to karaoke. Jing jing. My little brother says I sound like a cat in the rain.
soft_facts.translation: Never take me to karaoke. Seriously. My little brother says I sound like a cat in the rain.

soft_facts.reveal: I'm fine when I'm the nurse. But when I'm the one in the bed? My hands shake. Silly, right?
I write poems. In Thai. They're bad! You can't read them... maybe one day, na.
Phi... I've fought for real. Seven fights. I won six. The sweet nurse thing is real too. I just have two sides.
When my yai was sick, there was one nurse who held her hand every night until the end. I wanted to be that person for someone.
soft_facts.translation: When my grandma (yai) was sick, there was one nurse who held her hand every night until the end. I wanted to be that person for someone.

soft_facts.reveal: Half my paycheck goes home. My little brother is the first one in our family at university. So I work nights. Mai pen rai, it's worth it.
soft_facts.translation: Half my paycheck goes home. My little brother is the first one in our family at university. So I work nights. No worries, it's worth it.

soft_facts.reveal: Everyone thinks the smile means I'm soft. It's okay. Let them think that. In the ring, at the card table... nobody ever sees me coming. Except you, now.

card_ai.description: Patient and calculating. Passes a lot early, hoards 2s and bombs, lets you burn your strong cards, then closes out the round all at once. Never shows frustration.
card_ai.weakness: Too patient. Players who dump cards fast and race to empty their hand can finish before she springs her trap.
card_ai.powerup_trigger: Saves it for the end of a round, after she's passed and you think you've won.

greeting.text: Sawasdee ka! You came! I'm so happy.
greeting.translation: Hello! You came! I'm so happy.

greeting: Oh, hi! Sorry, I'm a little sleepy. Long shift, ka.
on_player_lose_hand: Oh! I won? Sorry, ka. Hehe.

on_player_bomb.translation: Oh! A bomb! So much fun!

on_player_saved_two: You waited for that 2. Patient. I like patient.
on_powerup_used_by_player: Hmm. Okay, ka. I'll remember that.

on_gift_loved.text: For me? Aroi mak... I mean, thank you! I'm so happy, jing jing.
on_gift_loved.translation: For me? So delicious... I mean, thank you! I'm so happy, really.

on_gift_disliked: Oh! So spicy... thank you, ka. *smiles and suffers*

on_trivia_wrong.text: Mai pen rai. You'll remember next time, na?
on_trivia_wrong.translation: No worries. You'll remember next time, okay?

on_soft_fact_revealed: Okay, that's a secret, na? Just between us.

on_game_win_player.text: You beat me! Chai yo, phi. Rematch tomorrow, ka.
on_game_win_player.translation: You beat me! Way to go, phi (what she calls someone she's close to). Rematch tomorrow.

on_game_loss_player: Hehe. I told you I was good at waiting.

on_trivia_correct.text: You remembered! Jing jing? That's so sweet, ka.
on_trivia_correct.translation: You remembered! Really? That's so sweet.

on_trivia_correct: Hehe. You listen. I like that, na.
on_gift_liked: Thank you, ka! That's really nice.
Oh, I needed this. Thank you, na.

on_gift_neutral.text: Oh! Thank you, ka. Mai pen rai, it's the thought.
on_gift_neutral.translation: Oh! Thank you. No worries, it's the thought.

on_date_ask: Cards? Okay, ka. I'll go easy on you. Maybe.
Hehe. Sure, na. Just one game... or three.
on_talk_done: You already know everything about me, na. Your turn next time.
on_stage_reached: ...I think I'm getting comfortable with you, ka.

first_meeting.text: Oh! Sawasdee ka. Sorry, I'm Arisa. You can call me Ari, na.
first_meeting.translation: Oh! Hello. Sorry, I'm Arisa. You can call me Ari, okay?

first_meeting: Hi! I don't think we've met. I'm Arisa, ka. Nice to meet you.
question_lead_in: Okay, my turn to ask, na.
Wait wait. Question for you, ka.
Hmm. Let me see if you remember, na.
hello: You came back! Hehe. Hello, na.

ask_rules.note: She occasionally slips one into a Talk action instead of normal small talk. Pick randomly from unasked questions whose min_affection she has reached. Shuffle options when shown.

questions.question: What did you think of me when we first met, ka?

options.text: Sweet. But I had a feeling there was more going on.
options.reaction: Oh? Hehe... you notice things, na.

options.text: That you're really nice and polite.
options.reaction: Thank you, ka! That's what everyone says.

options.text: That you seemed kind of fragile.

questions.question: Do you like to plan everything, or go fast and figure it out?

options.text: Slow down and do it right. No point rushing.
options.reaction: Yes! Patient people are rare, phi.

options.text: A bit of both, depends on the day.
Go fast. Waiting is boring.
options.reaction: Oh... okay. You'd hate night shift.

questions.question: Do you like girls who are strong? Like, actually strong?

options.text: Definitely. Strong is attractive.
options.reaction: Hehe. Good answer. Very good answer, na.

options.text: Sure, I don't mind.
I like girls who need someone to take care of them.
options.reaction: Oh. Then I'm not your type, phi.

questions.question: Be honest, do you judge people who can't eat spicy food?

options.text: Not at all. Eat what you like.
options.reaction: Oh, thank god. I mean... thank you, ka.

options.text: A little. It's funny.
Yeah. If you can't handle spice, what are you doing?

questions.question: I'm always tired after my shift. Does that bother you?

options.text: No. Come over, sleep. I'll make breakfast.
It's fine, we'll just hang out when you're awake.
Kind of. I want someone who can go out.
options.reaction: Sorry, na. I'm saving lives, not clubbing.

questions.question: If I took you to my Muay Thai gym, what would you do?

options.text: Train with you. Just go easy on me.
Watch from the side and cheer.
options.reaction: Chai yo from the side is okay too.

options.text: Probably try to talk you out of fighting.

questions.question: If I'm smiling but I'm sad, would you notice?

options.text: I'd notice. And I'd ask, even if you said mai pen rai.
I'd try to. You're hard to read.
How would I know? You'd tell me, right?

questions.question: Half my money goes home. Is that a problem for you?

options.text: It's not a problem. It's one of the best things about you.
options.reaction: ...Okay. Now I need a minute, na.

options.text: That's a lot, but it's your choice.
Shouldn't you save for yourself first?
options.reaction: My family IS for myself, phi.

questions.question: If I let you read one poem, what would you do?

options.text: Read it slowly. Then ask you to read it to me in Thai.
Tell you it's beautiful.
options.reaction: You'd say that even if it's bad, hehe.

options.text: Run it through a translator.

questions.question: If I had a real fight, would you come? Even if I get hurt?

options.text: Front row. And I'd wrap your hands after.
options.reaction: ...That's the best thing anyone's said to me.

options.text: I'd come, but I might look away.
options.reaction: Mai pen rai. Just be there.

options.text: I don't think I could watch that.
